# Minimal workflow (no validator, no custom planner)

Goal: prove the adapter needs nothing but the contract.

This minimal workflow produces only the contract elements: a Goal line, task
sections, tasks, and completion requirements. There is no validate.mjs anywhere
in this workflow, no custom milestone prompt, and no planning validator.

## S-01 Only story

- [ ] T-01 Do the one thing

## Completion Requirements

- CR-001: the one thing is done
